name: myx
description: MyX — personal life manager (Cloudflare Workers + Pages + D1)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta -k "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:web
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
